title: Add exact C3 gather rank-shape obstruction
body:
## Result

Adds a source-pinned scoped negative result for a three-source, one-destination gather child on the selected width-73 local word. The complete finite domain is every three-consecutive-ADD window in A or B with one common destination, three distinct source registers not equal to the destination, and at least two positive frame climbs across the touched registers.

For each window, the exact value map is `D += c1*S1 + c2*S2 + c3*S3`, with source values preserved. The hypothetical child replaces every positive destination and source frame increment with one child of rank equal to their sum. Exact weighted interval scheduling selects 16 of 32 windows, eight rank-12 and eight rank-16 children. This rank-mass-preserving max-saving profile raises the fixed-word ceiling by 1.3641268145%.

More strongly, exact per-window saving upper bounds and interval scheduling prove that every allowed schedule leaves the moment above one at 1.05 times the baseline ceiling. The exact positive margin is in `CERTIFICATE.json`. This bound gives the gather mechanism zero cost for source collection, copies, adapters, helpers, extra frame handling, restoration, precision and hosting. It is a scoped negative for this consecutive C3 gather family; it does not rule out other arities or schedules, admit a physical supplier, or claim a new kappa.

## Pins and reproduction

The package records OS-random seed `7a6da0d3a89bdb0425f85454db15342b`, `complex-mechanisms` / `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, catalogue revision 3, exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`, selected-record and assembly hashes, and compressed/decompressed local-word hashes. `SOURCES.json` pins source blobs at that base. The final exact-gather overlap refresh covered 473 open PRs and 449 Discussions with complete pagination and no warnings; there were no remote matches.

Registered commands:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-gather-child-seed7a6d --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-gather-child-seed7a6d
```

Local verification: exact verifier passed; all seven focused controls passed; package metadata/source-pin checks passed; `git diff --cached --check` passed. These direct runs used Python 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is not installed in this environment, so the registered Python 3.12 replay was not run locally.

## Scope and credit

The selected PR1094 construction and inherited obligations are unchanged. The package distinguishes PR1799's one-source/three-destination scatter, the adjacent diagonal rank-16 batching claim, and prior same-source coefficient reuse. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance is disclosed in `TASK.json` and `README.md`.
